items.title: 2026-018: Critical Vulnerabilities in PHP
items.summary: CERT-EU advisory on two critical PHP flaws allowing unauthenticated remote code execution, fixed in 8.5.12, 8.4.27, 8.3.36 and 8.2.35. PoCs are circulating, raising exploitation risk.

items.title: 2026-019: Critical Vulnerability in GitLab Community and Enterprise Editions
items.summary: GitLab patched a critical flaw permitting unauthenticated arbitrary code execution on the server. CERT-EU urges prioritising internet-facing instances and compromise assessment.

items.title: 2026-017: Critical Vulnerability in Cisco Secure Email Gateway
items.summary: Cisco Secure Email Gateway's AMP feature has a critical flaw enabling unauthenticated remote attackers to write files and run commands as root; Cisco PSIRT confirms active exploitation.

items.title: Critical Apache HTTP/2 Flaw Could Let Unauthenticated Attackers Execute Code Remotely
items.summary: CVE-2026-119618 in Apache HTTP Server's mod_http2 allows unauthenticated remote code execution on versions 2.4.55-2.4.70; fixed in 2.4.71. Only servers with HTTP/2 enabled are affected.

items.title: ScreenConnect Attacks Target at Least 288 Endpoints Across 48 Organizations With Rogue Clients
items.summary: ConnectWise disabled five third-party ScreenConnect extensions after unauthorized access reports; rogue clients reportedly hit at least 288 endpoints across 48 organisations. No infrastructure compromise or product flaw identified so far.

items.title: ARTEX and AI-Powered Red Teaming Tools: What Defenders Need to Know
items.summary: Unit 42 analyses attacker abuse of ARTEX and other AI-powered red teaming frameworks, with defensive guidance. CERT.at notes CERT-EU warns of a rapid increase in such agentic attacks.

items.title: Active ScreenConnect attacks breach MSPs, impact dozens of organizations
items.summary: ConnectWise is investigating an active campaign abusing compromised ScreenConnect environments at MSPs to push rogue remote-access clients to customer endpoints.

items.title: N-able Takes N-central Platform Offline After Discovery of 33 Flaws
items.summary: N-able took its N-central RMM platform offline after 33 flaws were discovered, releasing a hotfix amid public exploits for alleged zero-days enabling attacker takeover.

items.title: The global socket: how threat actors are weaponizing GSocket for stealthy C2
items.summary: Microsoft details threat actors deploying GSocket on compromised Linux servers to retain encrypted remote access after the initial vulnerability is patched, with detection and remediation guidance.

items.title: Microsoft Patch Tuesday November 2026, (Tue, Nov 10th)

items.title: Content protection bypass in ProfilePress
items.summary: ProfilePress versions earlier than 4.17.6 may not enforce certain content-protection rules when protected material is handled outside the main WordPress query. An unauthenticated remote user could access affected protected pages through the REST API when those rule conditions are in use.
items.mitigation: Upgrade ProfilePress to version 4.17.6 or later. Until upgrading, restrict REST API access where operationally feasible and review pages protected by the affected rule configurations.

items.title: Unauthenticated REST API authorization bypass in Security For WooCommerce
items.summary: Security For WooCommerce through version 1.0.16 exposes REST API routes without required access controls. An unauthenticated attacker who can reach those routes may obtain login tokens and access arbitrary user accounts, including administrator accounts.
